title: Who Is the Teacher?
instructions: 本材料为项目原创模拟教学材料，情境和数据均为模拟，非官方试题，未经真实考生难度标定。先读题，再听录音；建议第一遍抓大意，第二遍核对细节。共 8 题；单选题只选一个完整选项。填空用录音中的英文原词或数字，遵守每题词数限制。
transcript: Anna: Hi, Li Ming. Is this your classroom? Li Ming: Yes, it is. Anna: Who is your teacher? Li Ming: Mr. Wang is my teacher. Anna: Is he a Chinese teacher? Li Ming: No, he is not. He is an English teacher. Anna: Who is that woman? Li Ming: She is Ms. Li. She is a math teacher. Anna: Is she your teacher? Li Ming: No, she is not. She is not my teacher. Anna: Are you a student? Li Ming: Yes, I am. Anna: Is your friend a student? Li Ming: Yes, he is. His name is Tom. Anna: Is Tom a teacher? Li Ming: No, he is not. He is a student.

questions.explanation: 录音中李明说“Mr. Wang is my teacher.”，所以他的老师是王老师。
安娜问“Is he a Chinese teacher?”，李明回答“No, he is not.”，所以王老师不是语文老师。
questions.evidence: Anna: Is he a Chinese teacher? Li Ming: No, he is not.

questions.prompt: 从录音中抄写一个英文词：He is an ______ teacher.（王老师教的科目）
questions.explanation: 李明说“He is an English teacher.”，所以王老师是英语老师。
安娜问“Who is that woman?”，李明回答“She is Ms. Li.”，所以那位女士是李女士。

questions.prompt: 李女士是李明的老师吗？
questions.explanation: 安娜问“Is she your teacher?”，李明回答“No, she is not.”，所以李女士不是李明的老师。
李明说“She is a math teacher.”，所以李女士教数学。
安娜问“Are you a student?”，李明回答“Yes, I am.”，所以李明是学生。
questions.evidence: Anna: Are you a student? Li Ming: Yes, I am.

questions.explanation: 安娜问“Is Tom a teacher?”，李明回答“No, he is not. He is a student.”，所以汤姆不是老师。

grammar.title: be动词否定句与一般疑问句
grammar.explanation: be动词（am, is, are）的否定句是在be动词后加not，如“He is not a teacher.”。一般疑问句是把be动词提到主语前面，如“Is he a teacher?”。回答时用Yes或No，如“Yes, he is.”或“No, he is not.”。

questions.explanation: 否定句在be动词后加not，所以“She is not a doctor.”正确。

questions.prompt: 将“He is a teacher.”改为一般疑问句：
questions.explanation: 一般疑问句将be动词提前，所以“Is he a teacher?”正确。

questions.prompt: 你用 I 对“Are you a student?”作简短肯定回答：
questions.explanation: 问句用are you，肯定回答用Yes, I am.。

questions.prompt: 对“Is she a teacher?”作否定回答：
questions.explanation: 否定回答用No, she is not.。
